title: Hat Tracker
tagline: My wife wears a Phillies hat every day. This helps her pick which one.
what: A web app I built for my wife. She logs which Phillies hat she wore each day, and it lines each day's hat up against how the Phillies did: the score, the lineup, what the team wore. It turns all of that into Hot Takes that help her pick the next one.
built: Pulls the schedule, scores and lineups from MLB's stats feed, checking every 30 seconds close to game time
Posts the starting lineup to our Discord as soon as it's out
Keeps a photo of every one of her hats and works out each one's win-loss record
Added the team's jersey and cap for each game, so a hat gets judged against what the team wore too
Hot Takes written in plain words, with a test that keeps them that way

making.problem: I wanted her pick of the day to come with each hat's record behind it.
how: Schedule, scores, lineups and uniforms come in from MLB's stats feed on their own
She logs the hat she wore that day
It works out every hat's record and splits
Hot Takes turn those numbers into a few plain lines for tonight
credits: Schedules, scores, lineups and uniforms come from MLB's public stats feed

moment.what: Before the deciding Wild Card game, I made the Hot Takes read like a person talking about tonight's game. She's picking a hat, not reading a stats sheet.
